name: Mitsurugi Souichi
source:
Souichi is just one of many people who were forced to participate in the game. Although he is mourning over his dead ex-girlfriend, he has vowed to stay alive without playing the game - he plans on finishing the game without killing anybody, even if that decision could cost him his life.

[spoiler]Assigned PDA card: Ace[/spoiler]

Souichi is just one of many people who were forced to participate in the game. Although he is mourning over his dead ex-girlfriend, he has vowed to stay alive without playing the game - he plans on finishing the game without killing anybody, even if that decision could cost him his life.
